paite: Mihausate aw, ngai dih uh, na tung ua gimthuakna hong tung ding ziak a kap in, mau tuaituai un.
heading: Mihausa Nuaisiah Hatte Tan
english: Come now, you rich, weep and howl for your miseries that are coming on you.

paite: Na goute uh aseta a, na puante uh leikha in ne khinta hi.
english: Your riches are corrupted and your garments are moth-eaten.

paite: Na dangka-eng uleh na dangkate uh atui-ek khinta hi; huan atui-ek uh nou hon theihpihtu ahi ding ua, meikang bang in na taksa uh akangse zou ding hi.
english: Your gold and your silver are corroded, and their corrosion will be for a testimony against you and will eat your flesh like fire. You have laid up your treasure in the last days.

paite: Ngai un, na lou ua buh at a kilohte loh amau khem a na piak louh uh akikou ua, buh atte mangbang kikou aw Sepaihte' Toupa bil ah alutta hi.
english: Behold, the wages of the laborers who mowed your fields, which you have kept back by fraud, cry out; and the cries of those who reaped have entered into the ears of the Lord of Armies.

paite: Khovel ah nuamsatak leh noptaltak in na hing ua, na thah ni bang un na lungtang uh na taisak uhi.
english: You have lived in luxury on the earth, and taken your pleasure. You have nourished your hearts as in a day of slaughter.

paite: Midiktat, nou hon douloute siam louh tangsak in na that uhi.
english: You have condemned and you have murdered the righteous one. He doesn’t resist you.

paite: Huchi in unaute aw, Toupa hong pai mateng kuhkaltak in om un. Ngai un, louneimi in vuahtui ke masa leh nanung amuh mateng leigah hoihtak angak zel hi.
heading: Kuhkal Ding A Thuhilhna
english: Be patient therefore, brothers, until the coming of the Lord. Behold, the farmer waits for the precious fruit of the earth, being patient over it, until it receives the early and late rain.

paite: Nou leng kuhkaltak in om un; na lungtang uh hihkip un; Toupa hong paina ding anaita hi.
english: You also be patient. Establish your hearts, for the coming of the Lord is at hand.

paite: Unaute aw, siam louh tang a na omlouhna ding un, kiphunkhum kei un; ngai un, kongkhak bul ah vaihawmpa adingh hi.
english: Don’t grumble, brothers, against one another, so that you won’t be judged. Behold, the judge stands at the door.

paite: Unaute aw, Toupa min a thugenmi zawlneite thuakdan leh akuhkaldan uh zuih ding in nei un.
english: Take, brothers, for an example of suffering and of perseverance, the prophets who spoke in the name of the Lord.

paite: Ngai un, athuak mite tuh nuamsa i chi uhi; Job kuhkaldan na zata ua, Toupa'n atawp a ahihdan leh Toupa hehpihna a adimdan leh azahngaih theihdan leng na mu uhi.
english: Behold, we call them blessed who endured. You have heard of the perseverance of Job and have seen the Lord in the outcome, and how the Lord is full of compassion and mercy.

paite: Himahleh ka unaute aw, bang teng tung ah, kichiam kei un; van lou in hiam, lei lou in hiam, thil dang himhim lou in hiam kichiam kei un, hiamhleh "hi" na chih uh "hi" henla, "hilou" na chih uh "hilou" hi hen; huchi lou in zaw siam louh tang in na om kha ding uhi.
english: But above all things, my brothers, don’t swear—not by heaven, or by the earth, or by any other oath; but let your “yes” be “yes”, and your “no”, “no”, so that you don’t fall into hypocrisy.

paite: Na lak uah thil hoih lou thuak a-om uhia? Thum uhen. Kipak a om uhia? Phatna la sa uhen.
heading: Thumna Thilhihtheihna
english: Is any among you suffering? Let him pray. Is any cheerful? Let him sing praises.

paite: Na lak uah damlou a-om uhia? Saptuam Upa samsak uhenla, ama'n Toupa min a sathau nilh in atung ah thum hen.
english: Is any among you sick? Let him call for the elders of the assembly, and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord;

paite: Huan ginna a thumna in damlou adam ding a, Toupa'n amah akaithou ding; thil ahihkhelh takleh ngaihdam ahi ding hi.
english: and the prayer of faith will heal him who is sick, and the Lord will raise him up. If he has committed sins, he will be forgiven.

paite: Huchi in hihdam a na omtheihna ding un, na khelhnate uh thupha kitawituah unla, kithumsaktuah un. Midiktat thumna in thil thupitak ahih zel hi.
english: Confess your sins to one another and pray for one another, that you may be healed. The insistent prayer of a righteous person is powerfully effective.

paite: Elijah leng eimah piandan bang pu mihing ahi a, vuah zuklouhna ding in phatuamngaitak in athum a, kum thum leh kha guk sung teng leitung ah vuah azu kei hi.
english: Elijah was a man with a nature like ours, and he prayed earnestly that it might not rain, and it didn’t rain on the earth for three years and six months.

paite: Athum nawn a, van in vuah azusak a, lei in agahte ahon suah hi.
english: He prayed again, and the sky gave rain, and the earth produced its fruit.

paite: Ka unaute aw, na lak ua mi kuapeuh thutak a kipan in pialmang henla kuahiam in pikik nawnleh,
english: Brothers, if any among you wanders from the truth and someone turns him back,

paite: mikhial alamhaihna a kipan a kiheisakpa'n sihna a kipan akha ahondam ding a, khelhna tampi akhuhsak lai ding chih kithei hen.
english: let him know that he who turns a sinner from the error of his way will save a soul from death and will cover a multitude of sins.
